pairs: Verbum quod factum est a Domino ad Jeremiam,
The word that came from the Lord to Jeremiah,
“Listen to the words of this covenant,
and speak to the men of Judah
and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
And you shall say to them:
Thus says the Lord, the God of Israel:
Maledictus vir qui non audierit verba pacti hujus
Cursed is the man who will not listen to the words of this covenant,
quod præcepi patribus vestris, in die qua eduxi eos de terra Ægypti,
which I commanded to your fathers in the day when I led them away from the land of Egypt,
et facite omnia quæ præcipio vobis,
and do all that I command you,
et eritis mihi in populum, et ego ero vobis in Deum:
and then you will be my people and I will be your God.
ut suscitem juramentum quod juravi patribus vestris,
So shall I uphold the oath which I swore to your fathers,
daturum me eis terram fluentem lacte et melle,
that I would give them a land flowing with milk
just as it is this day.”
And the Lord said to me:
Vociferare omnia verba hæc in civitatibus Juda,
“Shout all these words in the cities of Judah,
and in the streets of Jerusalem,
Listen to the words of the covenant,
quia contestans contestatus sum patres vestros, in die qua eduxi eos de terra Ægypti,
For when testing, I tested your fathers in the day when I led them away from the land of Egypt,
nor did they incline their ear. Instead,
sed abierunt, unusquisque in pravitate cordis sui mali:
each one of them walked in the depravity of his own evil heart. And so,
et induxi super eos omnia verba pacti hujus quod præcepi ut facerent,
I brought over them all the words of this covenant, which I instructed them to do.
But they would not do them.”
And the Lord said to me:
Inventa est conjuratio in viris Juda et in habitatoribus Jerusalem.
“A conspiracy has been found among the men of Judah and among the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
Reversi sunt ad iniquitates patrum suorum priores,
They have returned to the former iniquities of their fathers,
who refused to listen to my words.
et hi ergo abierunt post deos alienos,
And likewise, they have gone after strange gods,
so that they may serve them.
irritum fecerunt domus Israël et domus Juda pactum meum quod pepigi cum patribus eorum.
The house of Israel and the house of Judah have treated as void my covenant, which I made with their fathers.
Quam ob rem hæc dicit Dominus:
For this reason, thus says the Lord:
Ecce ego inducam super eos mala de quibus exire non poterunt:
Behold, I will lead evils over them, from which they will not be able to escape.
And they will cry out to me,
and I will not heed them.
And the cities of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem will go forth,
and they will cry out to the gods,
et clamabunt ad deos quibus libant,
et non salvabunt eos in tempore afflictionis eorum.
and they will not save them in the time of their affliction.
Secundum numerum enim civitatum tuarum erant dii tui,
For according to the number of your cities, so were your gods,
And according to the number of the streets of Jerusalem,
so did you establish altars of confusion,
altars to offer libations to Baal.
Tu ergo noli orare pro populo hoc,
et ne assumas pro eis laudem
you should not choose to pray for this people,
and you should not take up praise and petitioning on their behalf.
quia non exaudiam in tempore clamoris eorum ad me,
For I will not heed them in the time of their outcry to me,
in the time of their affliction.
Quid est, quod dilectus meus in domo mea fecit scelera multa?
Why has my beloved wrought great wickedness in my house?
numquid carnes sanctæ auferent a te malitias tuas,
How can the holy flesh take away from you your wickedness,
The Lord has called your name:
At the voice of a word,
a great fire was kindled in it,
and its greenery was burned up.
has pronounced an evil against you,
concerning the evils of the house of Israel
quæ fecerunt sibi ad irritandum me,
which they have done to themselves so as to provoke me,
Then you displayed their efforts to me.
And I was like a meek lamb,
who is being carried to be a victim.
et non cognovi quia cogitaverunt super me consilia,
And I did not realize that they had devised plans against me,
“Let us place wood upon his bread,
et eradamus eum de terra viventium,
and let us eradicate him from the land of the living,
et nomen ejus non memoretur amplius.
and let his name no longer be remembered.”
and who tests the temperament and the heart,
let me see your vengeance against them.
For I have revealed my case to you.
Propterea hæc dicit Dominus ad viros Anathoth,
“Because of this, thus says the Lord to the men of Anathoth,
qui quærunt animam tuam, et dicunt:
who are seeking your life, and who are saying:
‘You shall not prophesy in the name of the Lord,
et non morieris in manibus nostris:
and you shall not die by our hands.’
Because of this, thus says the Lord of hosts:
Behold, I will visit upon them.
Their young men will die by the sword.
filii eorum et filiæ eorum morientur in fame.
Their sons and their daughters will die by famine.
Et reliquiæ non erunt ex eis:
And there will be nothing left of them.
inducam enim malum super viros Anathoth,
For I will lead an evil over the men of Anathoth:
